audience: recruiters on a Gupy Premium or Enterprise account who review jobs and application summaries

useCases.title: List job summaries
useCases.text: Read job summaries from your Gupy recruitment account, so you can pick a job to review.

useCases.title: Review application summaries for one job
useCases.text: Read application summaries for one job with basic candidate names and IDs. Identity documents, medical data and hiring decisions are excluded.

useCases.title: See the recruitment steps of one job
useCases.text: Read the recruitment steps configured for one job and summarize them for a hiring team.

useCases.title: Map applications to recruitment steps
useCases.text: Read the steps and the application summaries for one job, then list how the applications spread across the steps.
